rec.name: Metafield-Driven Delivery Time Message (with/without Installation Service)
rec.status: Built — content maintained, reviewed by client (1 item needed correction)

what.text: A short delivery-time message shown for each product (shown for 'Sections', i.e. digital theme sections). The text depends on whether the product needs an installation service. Without installation: 'Available in seconds, integrated in minutes'. With installation: 'We install the section for you within 2-3 business days'. The text is stored in a product metafield called 'Lieferzeit' (Delivery time) and maintained per product via a Google Sheet.

why.text: Setting clear expectations about when and how the customer gets the product reduces uncertainty and post-purchase anxiety. The instant-delivery message stresses speed and low effort. The 2-3 day install message makes a service promise concrete, so the buyer knows what happens after paying. Both lower hesitation at the decision point.

how.text: Create a product metafield (single-line text) named 'Lieferzeit'. Fill it per product from a master sheet: one standard text for products that need no installation service, another for products that do. In the PDP template (near the price or add-to-cart button), output the metafield value if it is present, optionally with an icon. Update the metafield values in bulk (CSV import or the Shopify bulk editor) when the wording changes. Where exactly the message sits on the PDP is not documented in the ticket.

items: Two standard message variants: no installation required / installation required (2-3 business days)
Source-of-truth Google Sheet listing which products need installation (flagged ⛔ / ✅)

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'Lieferzeit' (text), created by the developer. Requires a theme PDP block or snippet that renders the metafield. Needs an up-to-date product list showing which items require installation. No app mentioned.

items: Support tickets or questions about delivery/installation
Share of orders with installation service
Refund or complaint rate related to delivery expectations
